_comment: Which GitHub wiki pages the public site (GitHub Pages) mirrors. 'include' is the whole list: add or remove one line to publish or unpublish a page. A wiki page that is not listed is not published (a new wiki page stays off the site until it is added here). A link from a published page to an unpublished one goes to that page on the GitHub wiki ('excluded_links': 'wiki') or is shown as plain text ('text'). Build: python site/build.py --wiki <path to IridescentCraft.wiki clone>
